title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Dispute Time Limits and Counts
content:
The Pocketwire Visa Debit Card dispute rules turn on the periods and counts below. "Days" are calendar days. "Business days" are Federal Reserve business days.

### Filing and documentation periods

| Card tier | Unauthorized dispute report window (days after the transaction date) | Merchant dispute window (days after the transaction date) | Merchant-resolution wait (days after first contacting the merchant) | Documentation upload period (days after filing) | Timely-notice period (business days after the transaction date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 60 | 120 | 15 | 10 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 60 | 120 | 15 | 10 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 60 | 120 | 15 | 10 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 60 | 120 | 10 | 14 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 90 | 120 | 7 | 14 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 120 | 120 | 7 | 14 | 2 |

### Credit, investigation and new-card periods

| Card tier | Provisional credit (business days after the report date) | New-card provisional credit (business days) | Investigation deadline (business days after the report date) | New-card investigation deadline (days after the report date) | New-card period (days after the card's activation date) | Disputes over the rolling 365 days above which provisional credit is withheld |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 10 | 20 | 45 | 90 | 30 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 10 | 20 | 45 | 90 | 30 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 5 | 20 | 45 | 90 | 30 | 4 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 5 | 20 | 30 | 90 | 30 | 5 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 3 | 20 | 30 | 90 | 30 | 6 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 3 | 20 | 30 | 90 | 30 | 8 |

**Column notes**

- The merchant-resolution wait is the number of calendar days a customer allows after first contacting the merchant, for disputes of goods not received, goods not as described and credit not processed.
- The new-card period is the number of calendar days after the card's activation date during which a disputed transaction counts as a new-card transaction. For such a transaction, the new-card provisional credit timing and the new-card investigation deadline take the place of the ordinary timings.
- The last column is a count: a customer whose disputes filed over the rolling 365 days before a new filing number more than this figure receives no provisional credit on the new dispute until its investigation ends.
